label: Néo-classique / suspension
blurb: Piano, cordes, temps suspendu, gravité sans mièvrerie.
core: neoclassical piano and strings, suspended time
modern chamber music, minimal and grave

grafts.label: Piano préparé
grafts.phrase: a prepared piano, muted and metallic strings

interaction.subtle: a dry prepared piano answers the main motif in the upper register, leaving its long notes untouched
interaction.structural: a prepared piano carries alternate statements of the main motif in the upper register, contrasting short muted attacks with sustained replies

grafts.label: Pluie & pièce
grafts.phrase: rain on the window and the room breathing

grafts.label: Bande dégradée
grafts.phrase: degraded tape loops of the piano itself

grafts.label: Cor lointain
grafts.phrase: a distant French horn far behind the strings

interaction.subtle: a distant French horn echoes the last notes of the motif in a lower register, only during rests
interaction.structural: a French horn takes over the motif in a lower register while the original lead leaves space, then the roles reverse

far.label: Arpège analogique
far.phrase: a soft analog synth arpeggio under the strings

far.label: Pulsation électronique
far.phrase: a slow electronic pulse beneath the chamber group

far.label: Guitare saturée lointaine
far.phrase: a distant overdriven guitar swell, like a storm far away

extra: the mechanics of the instruments audible

presets.label: Rivière obsédante
presets.note: Ostinato de piano, cordes pincées, obsession douce.
detail: an obsessive rolling piano ostinato, plucked and bowed cello, dark water flowing

presets.label: Choral de cordes
presets.ref: The End of All Our Exploring
presets.note: Cordes lentes, harmonie qui s'ouvre, consolation.
detail: slow strings opening like a chorale, felt piano drops, warmth growing from stillness

presets.label: Foyer fragile
presets.note: Piano nu puis cordes qui portent, émotion pudique.
detail: a lone piano theme, strings arriving to carry it, a modest restrained swell

presets.label: Néo-classique pulsé
presets.note: Ostinato minimaliste, pulsation électronique qui monte, cordes jusqu'au sommet.
detail: a minimalist piano ostinato, a slow electronic pulse creeping in beneath, strings rising to a weighty peak
